scripts.build: node -e "const u = (process.env.DATABASE_URL && !process.env.DATABASE_URL.startsWith('file:')) ? process.env.DATABASE_URL : (process.env.sasha_DATABASE_URL || process.env.sasha_DATABASE_URL_POOLED || process.env.sasha_POSTGRES_URL || process.env.DATABASE_URL_POOLED || process.env.POSTGRES_PRISMA_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL); if (u) { process.env.DATABASE_URL = u; require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts', {stdio:'inherit', env: process.env}); }" && next build
